abaqus_odb_field_inspection.technical_finding: Abaqus 2023 2D planar analysis does NOT output reaction force RF3 for user-defined elements (type=U1) in standard *Node Output requests. Standard RF contains only ('RF1', 'RF2').
abaqus_odb_field_inspection.consequence: An external driver cannot extract dual phase multipliers lambda_L directly from ODB RF field outputs.
abaqus_odb_field_inspection.validated_remedy: The external PDAS controller computes the exact mathematical phase residual vector R_d = F_phase(H) - K_phase(H) * d algebraically using the extracted nodal phase field d (from SDV1) and committed history H (from SDV2). This preserves exact KKT complementarity evaluation while keeping the production UEL bitwise frozen.
